blurb:
Wines from the Oliver & Osoyoos area include the Golden Mile and Black Sage Bench. The wines are distinct and recognized as B.C.'s first wine sub-region due to the unique climate, soil types, and wine styles.

The wines are imbued with unique flavours, tastes, aromas, and minerality found nowhere else. 

Hot summer sun and dry, arid climate create ideal conditions for late-ripening premium red grapes to thrive!

Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Syrah.
